hero.headline:
We're Here To Help Everyday People
Take Control Of Their Financial Future
hero.desc: Pay Yourself First was created to make financial stability accessible to everyone, not just the wealthy or very high-income earners. Our system gives people access to the tools, guidance, and support to earn more, keep more, and spend less through practical, real-world solutions.

who_we_are.headline: Who We Are
who_we_are.desc1: Pay Yourself First (PYF) is a financial empowerment company built on a simple belief: You deserve a clear, practical way to improve your finances.
who_we_are.desc2: As the cost of living rises and financial pressure grows, too many people feel stuck.
list: W-2 workers overpaying taxes without realizing it
Families spending more but saving less
Individuals working hard but falling behind financially.
who_we_are.desc3: PYF was created to solve these problems by giving you access to the tools, education, and professional support they need to gain financial control.
who_we_are.desc4:
Our company is built around a system. One designed to help people break
negative financial cycles, build financial stability, and move forward with clarity
and confidence.

origin.headline: Our Origin
origin.desc1: PYF was built by financial professionals with decades of experience guiding real people—just like you—toward better financial outcomes. Through this work, a consistent pattern emerged:
list: People earned money but struggled to keep it
Tax rules were confusing and costly
Financial tools used by the wealthy were out of reach for most
Many families headed toward an uncertain financial future
origin.desc2: The team behind PYF recognized a gap: people needed a system — not just products, tips, or one-time fixes, but a comprehensive approach that helped them improve their financial lives year after year.
origin.headline_bottom: PYF was created to fill that gap.

mission.headline: Our Mission
mission.subtitle: Our mission is simple
mission.desc: To help everyday people gain control of their finances by giving them access to tools, education, and expert support normally out of reach to them.
